_comment: Jev routing table v3, designed by hand from published model rankings (Jev itself was evaluated only on type and difficulty, against labelled messages, not on the answers of each target); the X column (Gemini 4 Argon, Codex for quick) and create's H cell (Claude Sonnet 5.5) were set on 2026-10-16 without a new evaluation; on 2026-11-13 every Gemini 3.8 Flash cell moved to Gemini 4 Hydrogen at the same effort, also without a new evaluation. Each type has one target per difficulty band L/M/H/X (Jev's 10-level score: 1-3 L, 4-6 M, 7-8 H, 9-10 X), written like a stored model with its effort; 'codex' is CODEX_MODEL. Every cell is checked at start-up and a bad one stops the Bot.

candidates._comment: Models Jev may pick when JEV_PICK is shadow or on (routing.pick_route). target is a routing entry; strength ranks them (a conversation never moves to a lower one). Owner anchor 2026-11-13: Gemini 4 Hydrogen is about Claude Sonnet 5.5; the other ranks are estimates until an answer-quality evaluation replaces them. Every other string field is the option Jev reads. Every table cell must be one of these targets.

hydrogen-low.what: fast general model: greetings, small talk, short factual answers, simple rewrites or translations of a sentence or two
hydrogen-low.not_for: multi-step reasoning, long writing, code, anything that must be looked up live

hydrogen-medium.what: general model at moderate effort: everyday explanations, recommendations, translations and edits of a few paragraphs
hydrogen-medium.not_for: hard math or code, long creative writing, live information

hydrogen-high.what: general model thinking longer: careful explanations, longer writing, planning and personal advice that needs judgment
hydrogen-high.not_for: quick replies, live information, hard code

sonnet-high.what: strong writer: long or stylistic creative writing, fiction, role-play scenes, polished prose
sonnet-high.not_for: short replies, facts, code, live information

opus-high.what: strongest writer and analyst: the hardest creative or analytical requests where quality matters most
opus-high.not_for: anything a smaller model handles; live information

argon-medium.what: strongest reasoner: the hardest problems, such as research-level math, complex system or code design, long multi-step analysis

codex-low.what: web search and code assistant at low effort: a quick lookup on websites, a one-line code question

codex-medium.what: web search and coding: current information from websites (news, prices, schedules), ordinary coding tasks, math

codex-high.what: web search and coding thinking longer: debugging, multi-file code, tricky math, research across several websites

grok-low.what: the only model with live X (Twitter) search, quick: what is being said on X now, a post or account; also casual chat

grok-medium.what: live X (Twitter) search with more care: summarising X discussion and trends; also opinionated conversation and advice

grok-high.what: live X (Twitter) search thinking longer: careful analysis of X discussion, harder advice and creative requests

_comment_needs: A type that only these backends can answer (live X posts need Grok's X search; the Bot's own <web>, <fetch> and <run> work for every model). Every cell of it must be on that backend.
_comment_image: A message with an image is not judged (Jev reads text only): it goes down this list in order, each one when the one before cannot answer, then on along MODEL_CHAIN. A conversation already on a Codex cell keeps that cell (and its band) for the image.
_comment_degrade: Quota and failure stand-ins, tried before MODEL_CHAIN. grok_spent: a Grok cell while chat is past its share of Grok's weekly quota (GROK_CHAT_MAX_WEEKLY_PERCENT, the share kept for X lookups shrinking as the reset nears), the breaker is open or Grok is off. live_x_without_grok: an X question when Grok cannot answer at all (the answer says it had no X search). claude_failed: an agy Claude cell that failed, by type. argon_failed: an Argon cell that failed (its small weekly pool spent, a 429), by type: the cell it replaced. argon_failed and claude_failed are also used straight away while their agy pool is under its reserve (AGY_RESERVE_PERCENT, shrinking as the weekly reset nears) or reported spent. codex_quota: at or past these used percentages Codex effort drops one level.
